title: Demis Hassabis Steps Down as DeepMind CEO, Reports Say
description: Recent reports indicate significant changes in Google's AI leadership, including the departure of Demis Hassabis.

sections.heading: Leadership Changes at Google
paragraphs: According to CNBC, Demis Hassabis is stepping down as DeepMind CEO. The Times also reports that Demis Hassabis is stepping down at Google.

sections.heading: Further Executive Departures
paragraphs: CNBC reports that Chief Scientist Jeff Dean is exiting the company. This news comes alongside reports of Hassabis's departure.

sections.heading: New AI Venture
paragraphs: WIRED reports that four of Google's top AI brains are leaving the company. According to WIRED, these individuals are launching their own AI startup.
